authority_source: Explicit current main-session Owner Adoption instruction for the reviewed replacement binding proposal, with per-ledger ceiling interpretation and scoped local commit only.
timestamp_meaning: Local recording time; not independently witnessed or signed
candidate_header_interpretation: Historical candidate header preserved unchanged; adoption is established by this record, not by the header.
owner_supplied_full_review: Current owner message reports full 124-line review ACCEPT; its F1 is recorded here without modifying proposal bytes.

attempt_ceiling_interpretation.schema_counter_scope: ATTEMPT_CEILING_BREAKDOWN is enforced per ledger, not as a global cross-ledger ceiling.
attempt_ceiling_interpretation.meaning: Across the failed and replacement disposable ledgers, one historical initiated Attempt plus two replacement arm Attempts can total three. The per-ledger counter does not mechanically enforce the cross-evaluation owner allocation. No general additional-ledger or additional-Attempt entitlement is created.

binding_requirement: Path membership alone is not authorization. Every replacement append or consumer must verify exact fixed binding, ledger/genesis/evaluation identity and applicable authority relationship; membership in a set of known ledger paths is insufficient.

preserved_history.phase_a_and_checkpoints: Historical; unchanged; no migration or retry

exclusions: governance_tools/external_tree_inventory_guard.py and related unreviewed material: excluded here and from later scoped implementation unless separately justified, reviewed and authorized
authorized_now: one scoped local commit of exact proposal and required authority/PLAN/canonical-memory records
durability_scope: Local durability only after committed identity verification
blob_provenance: No self-referential enclosing commit is embedded; baseline identifies parent
stop: After local commit and committed identity verification. Minimal production implementation requires separate authorization.
